H0_INTERPOLATION.purpose: unseen N from the same bit-range and generation distribution

family_details.SAFE_PRIME_FACTOR: smaller factor p=2r+1 with r and p prime; q generic 24-bit prime
family_details.P_MINUS_1_4096_SMOOTH_FACTOR: largest prime divisor of p-1 <= 4096; q generic 24-bit prime
family_details.P_MINUS_1_HAS_FACTOR_AT_LEAST_2_POW_20: largest prime divisor of p-1 >= 2^20; q generic 24-bit prime
family_details.SELECTED_MOD16_CLASSES: 128 instances with (p mod 16,q mod 16)=(1,15) and 128 with (3,13), after ordering p<q

hidden_data_publication_rule: NO_HIDDEN_INSTANCE_FACTOR_SEED_OR_ANSWER_BEFORE_CANDIDATE_FREEZE; publish replay material only after evaluation is irrevocably frozen

localisation_metric.candidate_output: at most 8 disjoint closed integer intervals within [3,floor(sqrt(N))]
localisation_metric.coverage: p is inside union of intervals
localisation_metric.width: number of odd integers contained in the interval union
localisation_metric.bits_saved: log2(M/max(1,width)), where M is number of odd integers in [3,floor(sqrt(N))]
localisation_metric.paired_gate_input: binary factor coverage at equal predeclared width budget

factor_metric.success: return integer d with 1<d<N and N%d==0
factor_metric.failure: timeout, exception, invalid divisor, or no divisor

paired_signal_gate.comparison: best predeclared eligible baseline at the same resource cap on identical hidden instances
paired_signal_gate.notes: w = candidate success/baseline failure; l = baseline success/candidate failure; test conditions on w+l and uses p=1/2 exact binomial null

promotion_rule: AFRD remains inside CAM-AIMATH-ND unless a reusable representation or sustained multi-task programme survives held-out, reduction, falsification, and human Portfolio review

GEN-A.implementation: Python standard-library reference generator in gen_a_reference.py
GEN-A.prime_candidate_rng: random.Random seeded from SHA-256 of an explicit seed string; visible seed may be public, hidden seed stays evaluator-side until reveal
GEN-A.primality: deterministic Miller-Rabin bases [2,3,5,7,11,13,17] for all factor candidates (<2^36)
GEN-A.duplicate_rule: reject duplicate primes within instance and duplicate N across all already-generated splits

GEN-B_INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_RAN.implementation: OpenSSL 3.x `openssl prime -generate -bits <b>` in a separate evaluator wrapper; no GEN-A code imported
GEN-B_INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_RAN.randomness: OpenSSL DRBG independently seeded by its runtime; evaluator records OpenSSL version and generated manifest
GEN-B_INDEPENDENT_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_RAN.replay: post-evaluation publication of exact sorted (N,p,q) manifest is authoritative replay material; no pre-freeze hidden values are committed
